title: The Way of Initiation, or How to Attain Knowledge of the Higher Worlds
author: Rudolf Steiner
description: Rudolf Steiner presents a path of inner discipline intended to develop spiritual perception. The work connects exercises in attention, moral conduct and self-observation with his account of knowledge beyond ordinary sensory experience.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/b29012454).
